name: M&M Cookies
desc: Thick chocolate chip cookies loaded with M&M's, better after a day in the fridge.

source.title: Best M&M Cookie Recipe
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (just barely softened butter, 1 cup light brown sugar, 3/4 cup granulated, 3 cups flour, 1 cup each chips and M&M's) and the same 15 to 60 minute chill and 375°F bake.

ingredients.raw: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, barely softened
1 cup milk chocolate M&M's, plus more for the tops if desired
ingredients.note: plus more for the tops if desired

steps: Line two baking sheets with silicone baking mats or parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream the butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar for 1 minute.
Add the eggs and vanilla and mix until combined.
Add the flour, baking soda and salt and mix only until combined.
Fold in the chocolate chips and M&M's.
Refrigerate the dough 15-60 minutes (or up to 24 hours). Preheat the oven to 375°F near the end of the chill.
Scoop 3 tbsp portions with a large cookie scoop and set 2 inches apart on the sheets. Press extra M&M's into the tops, if you like.
Bake 7-10 minutes, until the edges are barely golden brown.
Let the cookies set on the pan 2 minutes, then move to a cooling rack.
